previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of polymyositis, morbid obesity, interstitial lung disease, diastolic heart failure, type 2 diabetes, and recurrent venous thromboembolism was admitted for diffuse muscle weakness concerning for a polymyositis flare. She had elevated CK and CRP, was treated with three days of IV methylprednisolone, then transitioned to oral prednisone and mycophenolate. Her weakness improved, and CK decreased. She also had acute on chronic heart failure with mild dyspnea and fluid overload, managed with IV lasix and optimization of home medications. Hypertension was worsened by steroids and addressed by increasing losartan. Warfarin was restarted after a period of underuse. She was started on Bactrim for PJP prophylaxis and metformin for steroid-induced hyperglycemia. She was discharged home on a new medication regimen with close follow-up planned with rheumatology and her primary care team.

Brief Hospital Course:
Ms. ___ is a ___ female with morbid obesity, 
polymyositis, interstitial lung disease, DM type II, HFpEF, and 
recurrent DVT/PE on lifelong warfarin who presented with thigh 
pain and was found to have a L medial thigh abscess s/p I&D x2, 
with hospitalization complicated by polymyositis flare.

ACUTE ISSUES
==============
# L Thigh Abscess
Presented with L medial thigh pain, fevers, and found to have 
2x2 cm collection; underwent I&D in ED. Repeat U/S showed 
2.8x1.2x1.4 cm collection and underwent repeat I&D. Treated with 
Vanc/Cipro/Flagyl, then transitioned to Augmentin/Bactrim. 
Swab cultures grew GNRs and GPCs with mixed flora. Repeat LLE 
U/S showed 2.4x1.1x1.3 cm fluid collection communicating with 
I&D. Thigh lesion improved, with significantly less tenderness. 
WBC downtrended appropriately.

# Sinus Tachycardia
# Possible PE
Presented with several days of dyspnea and chest pain. H/o DVTs 
and PEs on lifelong warfarin, although previously 
self-discontinued. Underwent CTA with no obvious PE, although 
limited by body habitus. TTE with nl biventricular systolic 
function. Unable to give heparin gtt due to allergy; started on 
lovenox bridge to warfarin, but PTT noted to be elevated. Given 
elevated PTT, unclear role for bridging due to low suspicion for 
PE, and poor evidence for appropriate dosing in obese patients, 
lovenox discontinued. PTT thought to be high, but on re-draw 
from peripheral stick appropriate at 31. INR on discharge 1.3.

# Polymyositis
H/o polymyositis on home prednisone, CellCept and rituximab. 
Developed muscle weakness and uptrending CK here. Received IV 
Solumedrol, then continued on prednisone and tapered. CellCept 
and Rituximab held due to ongoing infection. CK downtrended to 
normal range at discharge.

# Acute on Chronic HFpEF
HFpEF, previously on torsemide 100mg daily. States she is not 
adherent due to polyuria. CXR with trace pulmonary edema. 
Initially diuresed here with IV Lasix, then declined further 
diuresis. Continued on home losartan and metoprolol.

# Vaginal Bleeding
Hospital course was complicated by intermittent vaginal 
bleeding. Of note, last menstrual period ___, and UCG 
negative in the emergency department. Vaginal bleeding was 
thought to be secondary to known history of PCOS versus fibroid 
bleeding in the setting of lovenox bridge to warfarin. Has a 
stable 3.9 cm fibroid on previous pelvic ultrasound on ___. 
Transabdominal pelvic ultrasound was obtained which was normal. 
On physical exam, patient noted to have vesicles 
along labia majora, although HSV was negative.

CHRONIC ISSUES
===============
#DM Type II
Home metformin, glipizide, liraglutide were initially held on 
admission.  Patient continued to have poorly controlled serum 
glucose, and was started on Lantus 25 units nightly and also 
Humalog 4 units 3 times daily with meals. Discharged on home 
regimen.

#OSA
Continued on home BiPAP at night.

#HTN
Continued on home metoprolol, losartan.

#Vitamin D Deficiency
Continued on home vitamin D supplementation.

TRANSITIONAL ISSUES
===================
[ ] Prednisone decreased to 10mg maintenance dose.
[ ] Unclear if needs continued PCP prophylaxis as only on 10mg 
prednisone, assess at next appointment. If prophylaxis needed, 
when finished with antibiotic course could continue 
single-strength Bactrim.

- ___
[ ] Rituximab, MMF held until antibiotics finish. Patient should 
start MMF on ___. Patient should follow up with Dr. ___ in

will decide when rituximab to be restarted).
[ ] INR subtherapeutic at 1.3 on d/c. Warfarin dose increased to 
7mg daily. Next INR check: ___.
[ ] Consider repeat A1C and insulin initiation in outpatient 
setting if indicated given high blood sugars during 
hospitalization (likely exacerbated by steroid burst).
[ ] Consider re-starting maintenance diuretic for HFpEF at 
cardiology follow-up if willing.
[ ] Consider non-urgent transvaginal US as part of diagnostic 
workup for vaginal bleeding.
